dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: It sure is nice to have a change of scenery and forget about my unfinished paper for a bit... Oh, drat, now I'm thinking about it again...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Are you going back? I'm kinda sleepy, so I'll be leaving in a minute, too...

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: I—I did it! Looks like my math ability is still intact after all. Hmm? You want to try my method, too? Okay, so, to start with, you need to use this formula...

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: How did I lose? I know I memorized the formula, and I'm sure the values were correct... I guess I just messed up the calculations? I need to go back over this one with a fine-tooth comb...

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: As long as I stick to this formula, technically everything should work out fine...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: I finally won... This was my first time trying to use real-time calculations during a card game. I was pretty sure I'd mess it up, but... looks like I managed to pull it off.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: I didn't get enough sleep last night, so my head's still all groggy... I just couldn't keep all the numbers in my head.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: This time, I'm gonna check and double check all my numbers.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: That was a lot of mental arithmetic for one game... but I guess it paid off, right?

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Where did I go wrong? Oh, did I skip a step by mistake...? Ugh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...
